task.title: Adding tags from an installed dictionary
task.shortdesc: You can add Direct Tags to components to provide additional semantic information. There are many reasons to add tags to components. For example, it is by adding a tag that you set up a component to be included in a Tagged Category for the purpose of configuring component permissions. You add tags by selecting a component and using the Edit Tags window to select and add individual tags or tag groups to the component. Belongs under Category management right after Adding and editing a tagged category.

li.p: One or more installed tag dictionaries. If necessary, add required tag dictionaries to the TagDictionaryService.If tagging offline, it is possible that no dictionaries are available. In that situation the system searches for tag dictionaries in alternate locations.

taskbody.context: This task describes how to use the Edit Tags window to add individual tags or tag groups from a dictionary that is installed in the station Services folder.If you are using tags to support multiple hierarchical navigation schemes, you may add more than one type of tag to a component. You can use Tag Groups for adding multiple tags in a single add action.

step.cmd: Right-click on the component that you want to tag and select Edit Tags from the window menu.
In the Edit Tags window, select a dictionary from the option list in the top left corner .

info.note: In the Search field, you can use a shortcut to designate the dictionary. Type hs: for Haystack, n: for Niagara, and similarly for other dictionaries.

step.stepresult: The top half of the window shows a list of tags available from the selected dictionary. Once a tag is assigned to the active component, the tag icon appears dimmed.

step.cmd: Use the filter fields to limit the number of selections.

choices.choice:
Type in the Search field. to filter by tag name. Tags are filtered immediately as you type.
If the list has only a single item, then it is selected by default.
If a tag name is a subset of another tag, adding a space selects the shorter tag by name.
For example, if you have both “chiller” and “chillerPlant” tags, typing "chiller" shows both tags. Adding a space after “chiller” filters out “chillerPlant” and shows the “chiller” tag only.
Entering a colon ":" filters for the tag dictionary that has the prefixed namespace.
For example, if you enter hs:temp you select the “hs” (Haystack) dictionary and the "temp" tag.

Select an option from the option list to filter based on validity options.
Show All: no filtering applied when this option is selected.
Valid Only: shows just the tags that are valid based on rules defined in the tag dictionary.
Best Only: filters tags in appropriate manager views based on the identity of the component; for example, whether it is a point or device.

step.cmd: Select one or more tags from the Tag Dictionary (top) pane and click the AddTag button to assign the selected tags to the component.

info.note: Select a Tag Group, if appropriate, to add several tags at once.

step.stepresult: The selected tags are added and appear in the Direct Tags table in lower half of the window.

step.cmd: Edit any tag value fields, as appropriate, and click the Save button to save the tag assignments.
For tags that have Ord type values (such as “hs:siteRef”), refer to the following image and steps as an example of how to add a link to your tag.

substep.cmd: Click the option list arrow located to the right of the tag value field.
Select the appropriate link type from the options menu.
Browse to the desired link and select it.
